title: Checkout errors spiking after Friday deploy
symptoms: Checkout requests failing with database connection errors; p99 latency 4.9s, error rate 25%, starting about 10 minutes after the v2.6.0 Friday deploy.
error_message: org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
log_snippet:
2026-09-11T15:02:00Z ERROR payments-api [pool-2] org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
p99_latency=4910ms error_rate=25.0% deploy=v2.6.0 (10 min ago)
notes: Recall should surface all 4 prior postgres_pool_exhaustion incidents on payments-api with dates and IDs -- the canonical 'incident 5 cites the past fix' demo moment.

title: Checkout errors again after the next Friday deploy
symptoms: Same connection-pool-exhaustion signature as the prior four incidents; on-call is about to try rolling back the deploy.
error_message: org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
log_snippet:

title: order-worker degraded Monday morning
symptoms: Job throughput on order-worker has dropped sharply since about 07:00 this morning; the processing backlog is growing and the cache layer is reporting it is out of memory.
error_message: cache layer out of memory, order-worker service health degraded
log_snippet:
2026-09-14T07:11:15Z PAGE order-worker service_health=DEGRADED reason=cache_oom
redis: OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'.
queue_backlog=42750 memory_used_pct=99.1%
notes: reflect should surface 'order-worker Redis OOM recurred on 3 consecutive Mondays (May-July) and was root-caused/fixed in INC-015 (TTL key-prefix mismatch)' -- a reappearance after that fix is a notable, non-obvious insight, not just a repeat match.

title: order-worker falling behind during Diwali Dhamaka Sale
symptoms: Orders are taking much longer than usual to move from 'placed' to 'confirmed' since the Diwali Dhamaka Sale kicked off a few minutes ago; the order pipeline looks like it's falling behind the incoming volume.
error_message: order-processing consumer group falling behind on the order-events topic
log_snippet:
2026-09-16T11:31:40Z PAGE order-worker service_health=DEGRADED reason=consumer_backlog
kafka: consumer group order-processing falling behind on topic order-events (partition 5)
backlog_messages=19870 processing_rate_msgs_sec=540 required_rate_msgs_sec=1500
notes: Rahul Mehta resolved both prior Kafka-lag-during-sale incidents; the briefing should suggest looping him in.

title: Recurring checkout errors after a Friday deploy
symptoms: Checkout error rate has spiked again shortly after today's Friday deploy, with the same connection-pool-exhaustion signature payments-api has shown after previous Friday deploys.
error_message: payments-api reporting critical service health, database pool exhausted
log_snippet:
2026-09-25T15:21:44Z PAGE payments-api service_health=CRITICAL reason=db_pool_exhausted
postgres: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
pool_utilization_pct=100.0% checkout_error_rate=26.3% deploy=v2.6.2 (9 min ago)
notes: This is the 5th occurrence of the pattern; INC-021's postmortem flags the order-confirmation session-leak fix as proposed three times and still not implemented -- the agent should flag this as a recurring incident with an open permanent fix, not just rank fixes again.
